question.text: Which of the following statements about PPF is INCORRECT?

answer.text: PPF interest rate is linked to G-sec rates and varies quarterly
PPF allows partial withdrawal any time after opening the account

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series X-B, PPF allows partial withdrawal only after completion of 5 financial years from the end of the financial year in which the account was opened, so the statement that partial withdrawal is allowed any time after opening the account is incorrect and is therefore the correct selection for an "INCORRECT" question. The other three statements - 15-year lock-in, G-sec-linked quarterly rates, and EEE tax treatment - are all supported by the source. The Trap: Candidates who recall only that PPF "permits partial withdrawal" without recalling the 5-year waiting condition will treat this statement as correct and miss the intended incorrect option. Note: Within the 15-year lock-in, the partial-withdrawal facility is the key liquidity nuance to remember; quote the 5-financial-year rule rather than a generic "anytime" or "after 5 years" formulation.
